quest.title: Aesthetic Critique: Self-Critique
quest.description: The painter Depierris seems to have encountered some trouble again...

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: No, no... If I remove the lights and shadows here, what will that do to the layering on the painting?

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: The power of expression in those colors is insufficient... and the contrast is not great either...

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: Ugh! Just a few elements removed, and the whole thing's a mess now!

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: Ah, it's you. It's good to see you again...

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: I apologize for the misunderstanding — I was merely thinking about the issues with this picture, and I couldn't help but pace about...

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: You might not be able to understand, but I simply cannot sit still when reflecting on problems.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: The longer I sit in place considering problems, the more frustrated I get. That's why I'm used to thinking as I pace.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: I allow my legs to carry me anywhere they will as I think, so long as they don't keep me in place.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: So... this happens often. Sorry for making you worry.

choices.text: So, did you reach a conclusion, then?

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: No progress, I fear... I just don't know where to begin.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: If I remove the lighting effects, the image lacks layers, but if I reduce contour and shaping, the objects within the picture cannot sustain its structure.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: The removal of just any few elements will send the whole edifice crashing down, devolving it into a heap of trash.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: I'm just talking to myself, by the way, so don't worry too much — I'm just thinking about how to solve this problem.

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: I must go back and look for my easel first...

choices.text: And what of the question you were considering?
I almost thought you were in danger or something.

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: Seriously, I was just painting over here — but before I knew it, they had me surrounded!

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: They attacked my painting so vigorously, you'd think they wanted to eat it or something!

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: But I couldn't let them have it, of course, so I grabbed it and ran...

dialogues.speaker: Depierris
dialogues.text: Didn't get far before they caught up, though — thank the Archons you were there to rescue me.

choices.text: Is there something wrong with this painting?

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: A—Archons if I know! I've always used Whopperflower Nectar to make my paints — you know, the stuff you got for me previously?

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: Wait... What if the paint was attracting them? No, that can't be — that nectar doesn't smell at all after I mix it into the paint!

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: I daren't change the paint formula on the fly, either. Guess we'll have to find some other way...

response.speaker: Depierris
response.text: *cough* And here I thought that even the Whopperflowers could sense the beauty in my painting and wanted to come have a look at it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look up ahead! Depierris is just over there. C'mon!
